text:
Ava - People Ops: Quick one — we're coordinating a lateral transfer for Priya (SWE II -> SWE II on Infra) but Jordan is requesting a payband exception + same-day promo to SWE III. Can we stack transfer + promotion effective the same day? Any hard rules on approving comp exceptions during transfers? /cc @Jordan - Manager
HR Bot: Policy excerpt: transfers do not automatically change compensation. Payband exceptions require Comp Committee review; typical lead time is 5–10 business days. See the Comp Exceptions doc: https://redwood.infra/docs/comp-exceptions :file_folder: 
Jordan - Manager: We think Priya already meets SWE III expectations based on recent deliverables. Budget for new team is tight though — can we fast-track approval so it aligns with the transfer date? :pleading_face:
Sara - IC: +1 from the team — Priya is doing SWE III work daily. Would help with retention to make this immediate.
Ava - People Ops: Short answer — yes, but it's treated as an exception and needs the Comp Committee + (sometimes) Finance sign-off depending on magnitude. Practical steps: 1) Manager submits the Comp-Change Request form (link below) with a short calibration packet (role profile, recent eval summary, 3x benchmark comps). 2) People Ops routes to Comp Committee. 3) If >20% delta or outside band, Finance review required. You can request an expedited review — include "expedite_reason" in the form. Typical turnaround: 5 business days; expedited: 2–3 days if committee has capacity.
Jordan - Manager: Got it. For >20% do we need a P&L owner sign-off or only Finance? Also, does this change equity schedule / refresh timing?
Ava - People Ops: For >20% increases we request Finance approval and budget owner acknowledgement (usually the director/VP owning that headcount). Equity refresh cadence is unchanged — promotions don't auto-trigger off-cycle equity grants unless Talent/Rewards approves a make-whole. If you want an off-cycle equity discussion, note that on the form and we'll loop Rewards.
Mike - Eng: Any impact on benefits enrollment windows or probation/90-day clocks when you transfer + promo?
Ava - People Ops: Benefits remain continuous — no new enrollment window unless the transfer crosses legal entities. The 90-day new-role goals are manager-defined; we don't reset seniority-based benefits.
Jordan - Manager: Helpful. One practical Q: if the comp committee asks for benchmark comps, what's the preferred format?
Ava - People Ops: Prefer a 1-pager CSV + one-paragraph justification. Example fields: role_title, current_level, requested_level, current_base, requested_base, comparator_company, source (e.g., Radford/Levels.fyi/internal). Paste the packet into the form or attach as PDF.
Sara - IC: If we get approval, can the effective date be backdated to the transfer Monday?
Ava - People Ops: We can set the effective date to the transfer date as long as approvals are finalized before payroll cutoff. If approvals come after payroll, comp changes will take effect next pay cycle and we'll do a retroactive adjustment.
Jordan - Manager: Thanks — I'll fill the form now. What flags should I mark to request expedited review?
Ava - People Ops: In the form choose 'Expedite: Yes' and include a one-line business justification + 'Retention risk' or 'Customer impact' tag. Also DM me the form link after submission and I'll ping the Comp Committee chair.
HR Bot: Quick links:
- Comp-Change Request form: https://redwood.infra/hr/comp-change-form
- Comp Exceptions policy: https://redwood.infra/policies/comp-exceptions.pdf
- Benchmark template (CSV): https://redwood.infra/templates/comp-bench.csv

Ava - People Ops: TL;DR: stacking transfer + promo is allowed but treated as an exception. Submit form + packet, request expedite if needed, loop Finance for >20% changes. I'll standby to escalate once Jordan files. :thumbsup:
Jordan - Manager: Filing now — will DM you the form link. Thanks everyone. :party_parrot:
